description: This file defines the ConsistencyTestOptions class, a configuration class for consistency testing in Orleans transactions, including properties for seed, number of grains, max depth, and read/write determinism, as well as an enumeration for read/write strategies.

classes.name: ConsistencyTestOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for consistency tests involving transaction grains in Orleans.

properties.name: NumGrains
properties.description: Number of grains involved in the test.

properties.name: MaxDepth
properties.description: Maximum depth for the consistency testing.

properties.name: AvoidDeadlocks
properties.description: Whether to avoid deadlocks during testing.

properties.name: AvoidTimeouts
properties.description: Whether to avoid timeouts during testing.

properties.name: GrainOffset
properties.description: Offset for grains, potentially used to vary grain IDs.

classes.name: ReadWriteDetermination
classes.description: Enumeration defining strategies for read/write behavior in the consistency testing.
